transitions.NO_GO->CONNECTION_VERIFIED: active Cloudflare account token plus account/zone/Tunnel/R2 read gates
transitions.CONNECTION_VERIFIED->DISCOVERY_VERIFIED: GET-only target Tunnel and R2 state known
transitions.DISCOVERY_VERIFIED->CHANGE_READY: manual exact-SHA P0-CF gate with WIF tag, least privilege, immutable image, CSI schema, egress policy, R2 plan, rollback and writes disabled
transitions.CHANGE_READY->CREATE_ONLY_APPLIED: separate explicit human confirmation CREATE_CLOUDFLARE_RUNTIME_RESOURCES and create-only/idempotent workflow
transitions.CREATE_ONLY_APPLIED->POST_CREATE_VERIFIE: real Tunnel/R2 resources, Bucket Lock, Tunnel token in OpenBao, real CSI mount, runtime-path 7844 connectivity, temporary R2 credentials and healthy cloudflared replicas
transitions.POST_CREATE_VERIFIED->RUNTIME_VERIFIED: checksum roundtrip, retention denial tests, tunnel failover, credential rotation, OTel evidence and exact-SHA evidence binding
transitions.RUNTIME_VERIFIED->PRODUCTION_VERIFIED: full project safety, quality, SLO, DR, sustained-operation and governance gates

invariants: no state may be inferred from configuration-only evidence
every runtime transition must be bound to exact source SHA and execution id
a later state cannot be entered when any required prior-stage gate is missing
Tunnel token must never be stored in GitHub secrets
Cloudflare control-plane token must never be reused as R2 S3 data-plane credentials
Bucket Lock must be verified before certified evidence object writes
DNS mutation and resource deletion are forbidden in the first change
